overall_goal: Grease and coat two ramekins with butter and flour

goals.rationale: The person retrieves ramekins from the dishwasher, wipes them out, and places them on the counter to prepare for greasing.

goals.description: Grease the first ramekin with butter
goals.rationale: The person takes butter from the dish and spreads it around the inside of the first ramekin to prevent the mixture from sticking.

goals.description: Grease the second ramekin with butter
goals.rationale: The person uses excess butter from the first ramekin and additional butter from the dish to coat the inside of the second ramekin.

goals.description: Apply the first coat of flour to the ramekins
goals.rationale: The person adds a spoonful of flour to one ramekin and shakes both ramekins together to distribute the flour evenly across their insides.

goals.description: Apply a second coat of flour and remove excess
goals.rationale: Realizing more flour is needed, the person adds another spoonful, shakes the ramekins together again, and empties the excess flour into a pan.
